title: 商用ASR系统在代码切换语音上的基准测试：阿拉伯语、波斯语和德语
summary: 针对代码切换语音这一ASR领域的难点，评估了五家商用ASR提供商在四种语言对上的表现。提出两阶段流水线筛选数据集，将LLM评分成本降低约91%。发现BERTScore比WER更适合评估阿拉伯语和波斯语。ElevenLabs Scribe v2在所有语言对上取得最低WER（整体13.2%）。公开了基准数据集。
summary_en: Benchmarks five commercial ASR providers on code-switching speech across four language pairs. Proposes a two-stage pipeline reducing LLM scoring costs by ~91%. Finds BERTScore more reliable than WER for Arabic and Persian. ElevenLabs Scribe v2 achieves lowest WER (13.2% overall). Dataset publicly available.
